title: A work order line keeps its inactive part and can still be edited
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create an active part, part A, for this test, with Sell Price $20.00 and 4 on hand.
  • Create an open work order, work order 1, for this test, whose approved line, line 1, holds 2 of part A at $20.00.
  • Set part A inactive after it is on line 1.
  • Start on work order 1, on its Lines tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click the part A row on line 1.
  2. Replace the quantity with 3.
  3. Click Save.
  4. Click the part A row on line 1.
  5. Replace the Sell Price with 22.00.
  6. Click Save.
  7. Click the part A row on line 1.
  8. Type Still on the line in the note field.
  9. Click Save.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The part A row opens for editing: it is still on line 1 of work order 1 with quantity 2 at $20.00 ($40.00).

Step 2:

  • The quantity reads 3.

Step 3:

  • The change saves and the row total reads $60.00 (3 × $20.00).

Step 4:

  • The part A row opens for editing.

Step 5:

  • Sell Price reads $22.00.

Step 6:

  • The change saves and the row total reads $66.00 (3 × $22.00), and the line total includes it.

Step 7:

  • The part A row opens for editing.

Step 8:

  • The note field holds the text.

Step 9:

  • The note saves and the row still holds part A.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work)

  • S9-E1: “A line that already holds a part when the part becomes inactive stays on its work order, estimate or part sale, including a completed part sale, and its totals keep calculating.”
  • S9-E2: “The user can still change the quantity, price and notes on that line, and save it again with the same part or number.”
  • Feature Overview, Core functionality: “An inactive part cannot be added to new work. It stays on every record it is already on, and it stays available for returns and credits.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
